title: The dog and the Datsun

logline: Week two of the dog. Barnaby learns the Datsun: the passenger seat, the window, the box. He sits on the box. Wood lets him.

panels.composition: The Datsun in the driveway. BARNABY on the passenger seat, upright, looking out. WOOD driving.

image.prompt: a small scruffy dog sitting upright on a car's passenger seat looking out the windshield while a young man drives, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The window down an inch. The dog's nose at the gap. Spruce going by.

image.prompt: close on a small dog's nose pressed to the gap of a car window with spruce trees blurring past, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Lot C. Wood getting out. The dog climbing into the back seat onto the taped box. Settling.

image.prompt: a small dog climbing onto a taped cardboard box on a car's back seat and settling down, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood walking to the building, looking back. The dog's face in the rear window, on the box. Everything, guarded.
